about_the_game:
Skyborn: IronWings reinvents the spirit of classic arcade shooters like Raiden—now unleashed in full 3D. Set in a high-tech sci-fi world, you’ll experience dynamic air combat not just on a flat plane, but across vertical space: dive from the sky to strike enemies on the ground, or engage enemy squadrons in the clouds above.

Enjoy fast-paced bullet hell action with upgradeable weapons, homing missiles, lasers, and powerful bomb attacks. Smart enemies take cover behind structures and strike from above and below, forcing you to maneuver, dodge, and dominate a battlefield that spans both altitude and tactics.

⚠️ The current demo supports single-player gameplay. Co-op multiplayer battles will be available in the full release!
